name: Kingdom of Belgium

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 30,494 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 11,941,781. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS 2025 as quoted (p.72): 23,500 active. CIA Factbook 2025 ~23,000 (low).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 23,500 minus infantry P roles (4,500). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Small all-volunteer force with no stored equipment; analogy to 1940 Belgium (~650,000 from 8.4 million, ~8%) at the high end.

commandQuality.note: Rubric commandQuality 0.5 (competent staff, average generalship) (slightly above): NATO-integrated staff, small expeditionary contributions (Mali, Iraq air ops).

cohesion.note: Rubric cohesion 0.75 (professional with strong unit identity) (slightly below): Professional; linguistic split managed.

morale.note: Rubric morale 0.5 (average) (slightly below): Average to low appetite for combat.

weapons.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Precision munitions on F-16/F-35; light land weapons.

armor.note: Between anchor 8 and 9: No tanks; wheeled armour only.

ships.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Frigates and new drone-based MCM.

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: A400M, NATO logistics hub (Antwerp).

communications.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: NATO HQ host, Link 16.

isr.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Limited national ISR.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 606,910,945,391 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 11,941,781 = 50,822. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 758,164,828,720 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 606,910,945,391 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.01% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 1.28% in 2024, 1.04% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 18.6% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Net exporter of processed food, imports feed.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 5,891,251 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 6.128% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 72,204. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. John Cockerill turrets/FN Herstal small arms; no AFV hull production.

roadKm.note: As quoted: 118,414 km, all paved (2015); 1,747 km motorway.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 3,612 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 6,874 thousand DWT under the Belgian flag.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. Belgium hosts US B61 bombs at Kleine Brogel under NATO nuclear sharing (FAS); not counted.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1: familiar terrain, urban density; no depth.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:BEL. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Belgium has no tanks or tracked vehicles (disbanded 2010s) and only light artillery; the CaMo programme brings Griffon/Jaguar/CAESAR. Force counts from the Wikipedia Belgian Army equipment list and Belgian Air Force inventory; navy counts grade C. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D).
